modern-luxury-villa.title: Modern Luxury Villa
modern-luxury-villa.tagline: A multi-level contemporary sanctuary combining raw concrete textures with warm teak accents.

narrative.title: Architectural Concept & Design Vision
narrative.story: Designed with a sustainable biophilic philosophy, this luxury villa features floor-to-ceiling glass facades that maximize natural daylight while preserving total family privacy. The structural cantilevered master suite extends seamlessly over an outdoor courtyard pool.

keyHighlights: Cantilevered Master Suite over central courtyard pool
Integrated 100% solar-assisted microgrid & rainwater harvesting
Custom acoustic teak wall panelling and Italian marble flooring
Automated smart home climate & ambient lighting controls

gallery.caption: Double-Height Living Space with Ambient Lighting

contemporary-interior.title: Contemporary Interior
contemporary-interior.tagline: Minimalist luxury interior design combining ambient architectural lighting with bespoke custom woodwork.

narrative.title: Design Philosophy & Spatial Flow
narrative.story: A complete interior overhaul prioritizing spacious layouts, acoustic wall panelling, and soft earth tones. Every piece of furniture was crafted on-site by master artisans to harmonize with the structural geometry of the residence.

keyHighlights: Concealed ambient LED lighting channels throughout living areas
Custom acoustic wood slat accent walls in private lounge
Bespoke Italian quartz kitchen countertops with soft-close cabinetry

gallery.caption: Main Lounge Area with Ambient Lighting

commercial-workspace.title: Commercial Workspace
commercial-workspace.tagline: State-of-the-art corporate office facility designed for agile collaborative teams.

narrative.title: Structural Execution & High-Density Engineering
narrative.story: Built from the ground up, this modern commercial facility integrates open-plan workstations, executive lounges, high-performance HVAC systems, and a striking double-glazed glass facade.

keyHighlights: Double-glazed soundproof glass facade reducing heat load by 35%
Integrated rooftop green garden and breakout spaces
High-density commercial power backup & climate infrastructure

chettinadu-heritage-residence.title: Chettinadu Heritage Residence
chettinadu-heritage-residence.tagline: Traditional Chettinadu architectural grandeur built with modern structural engineering standards.

narrative.title: Blending Cultural Heritage with Contemporary Utility
narrative.story: Currently under active construction, this project features authentic Athangudi tile flooring, hand-carved teak wood pillars, and an expansive open-sky central courtyard (Thinnai).

keyHighlights: Traditional open-sky courtyard central cooling dynamics
Authentic hand-carved solid teak wood pillars
Custom hand-crafted Athangudi ornamental floor tiles

video.caption: Live Site Progress & Structural Framing Tour

zenith-turnkey-duplex.title: Zenith Turnkey Duplex
zenith-turnkey-duplex.tagline: End-to-end turnkey architectural delivery from foundation to final interior handover.

narrative.title: Seamless Single-Source Turnkey Execution
narrative.story: Delivered as a complete turnkey solution, Prerana Architects managed the full project lifecycle: architectural blueprints, civil construction, interior woodwork, and MEP engineering without schedule slippage.

keyHighlights: Single-point project management from groundbreaking to handover
Custom floating steel staircase with glass balustrades
Zero schedule slippage with modular timber fabrication

minimalist-penthouse-interior.title: Minimalist Penthouse Interior
minimalist-penthouse-interior.tagline: High-altitude penthouse interior utilizing clean lines, concealed storage, and monolithic stone finishes.

narrative.title: Monolithic Elegance & Panoramic Views
narrative.story: Designed to frame sweeping urban skyline views, this penthouse interior emphasizes uncluttered spatial freedom, concealed cabinetry, and warm indirect cove lighting.

keyHighlights: Custom concealed wall closets with push-to-open hardware
Panoramic floor-to-ceiling glass wall framing city views
Monolithic Italian marble island unit in open dining zone

urban-boutique-commercial-mall.title: Urban Commercial Complex
urban-boutique-commercial-mall.tagline: Multi-level commercial retail and lifestyle destination currently undergoing structural completion.

narrative.title: Contemporary Retail Architecture
narrative.story: Designed for heavy foot-traffic and maximum retail visibility, this commercial complex features double-height atrium spaces and energy-efficient climate control systems.

keyHighlights: Double-height central retail atrium space
Multi-tier basement parking with automated ventilation
High-durability granite and composite exterior cladding
